items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: He recorded with me... Coleman Hawkins was an extra added attraction on my album. He helped sell my album... willing to record with me.

ctx.x: You two must have been something together.

A very funny guy. Very, very humorous. He has a good attitude and he loves to play and a great player. I don’t use that word loosely. To me that word “great” Monk is a superlative. Benny Goodman, great. Louis Armstrong, great. Teddy Wilson, great. Art Tatum, great. Jess Stacy, piano, great. Mel Powell, great. And there were some good players. But the ones I just mentioned, great. Lionel Hampton, great. Harry James, great. Ziggy Elman, great. Toots Mondello, great. Hymie Schertzer, great. Johnny Hodges, great,…
Was it a ten inch record at that time?
